author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
This QuickBooks Online tutorial for construction shows you how to run payroll and track job costs so every hour your crew works flows to the right project and you know which jobs actually made money. 💵 Get 50% off QuickBooks Payroll ➜ https://qbpayroll.kevinstratvert.com/ 

First, you'll see which QuickBooks plan combination fits a construction business, with Payroll Premium for time tracking from the job site and QuickBooks Plus for project profitability. 

Next, you'll set up your jobs as projects in QuickBooks so every invoice, expense, and labor hour flows back to a specific build. 

Then, you'll add your construction crew with multiple pay rates per employee, so the same person gets paid one rate for demo work and a different rate for carpentry in the same week. 

Afterward, you'll add subcontractors with electronic W-9s and bill their work to the right job, ready for 1099-NEC filing at year-end.
